text: [45] sattimā bhikkhave saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā . katamā satta asubhasaññā #1 ma. parappavādā . 2 ma. gatanti . 3 ma. upavāyatanti . maraṇasaññā āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā aniccasaññā anicce dukkhasaññā dukkhe anattasaññā imā kho bhikkhave satta saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti .
